_readme: Armor framing test. Goal: armor shaped as if on a mannequin, with no person, mannequin, face, or weapons. Subjects = 4 phrasings (P1-P4); styles = style x guidance settings. 2 seeds each to judge reliability, not luck.
name: armor1
title: Armor framing test: phrasings (columns) x style/guidance (rows), 2 seeds
framing: single subject centered, entire subject visible, plain flat light grey background
palette: warm golden saturated palette, early frontier era
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, cropped, cut off, busy background, scenery, landscape, ground, environment, blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, deformed, person, people, human, man, woman, face, eyes, head, hair, skin, hands, fingers, character, character sheet, turnaround, multiple views, model sheet, mannequin, dress form, display stand, hanger, weapons, sword, spear, bow, gun, knife

subjects.label: P1 ghost-mannequin term
subjects.prompt: ghost mannequin apparel product shot of a Unity scout outfit: hooded travel cloak, quilted tunic, leather belts and pouches, woven sash with folk embroidery, trousers and soft leather boots, hollow clothing standing upright with a visible empty neck opening and the dark empty inside of the hood

subjects.label: P2 empty outfit floating
subjects.prompt: an empty Unity scout outfit floating upright by itself as if worn by an invisible spirit: hollow hooded cloak with nothing inside the hood, quilted tunic, leather belts and pouches, woven sash with folk embroidery, empty sleeves, trousers, soft leather boots

subjects.label: P3 inventory icon, hollow shell
subjects.prompt: game inventory icon of the Unity scout armor set as one standing hollow shell: hooded cloak draped over a quilted tunic, belts and pouches, embroidered sash, trousers and boots, the hood opening is dark and empty

subjects.label: P4 torso only (cloak + tunic)
subjects.prompt: game inventory icon of a Unity scout armor set: hooded cloak over a quilted tunic with leather belts, pouches and an embroidered folk sash, standing by itself as a hollow three-dimensional garment, empty hood, empty sleeves

styles.label: Painterly crisp, cfg 2 (default)
styles.prompt: visible brushstrokes, soft blended gradients, crisp clean defined edges, thin dark outline around the silhouette, high readability
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, vector, blurry edges

styles.label: Painterly crisp, cfg 3.5 / 8 steps
styles.prompt: visible brushstrokes, soft blended gradients, crisp clean defined edges, thin dark outline around the silhouette, high readability
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, vector, blurry edges

styles.label: Vector sticker, cfg 3.5 / 8 steps
styles.prompt: bold uniform dark outline, flat colors with one hard shadow tone and one highlight tone, simplified geometric shapes, crisp edges
styles.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, texture, brushstrokes, soft gradients
